headword: お{弁当|べんとう}{温|あたた}め

definitions.gloss: bento heating service; warming up boxed meals
definitions.explanation: A service offered at convenience stores where staff will heat up your purchased bento or food items in a microwave.

examples.japanese: お{弁当|べんとう}、{温|あたた}めますか？
examples.english: Would you like me to heat up your bento?
examples.notes: Standard question from convenience store staff

examples.japanese: お{弁当|べんとう}{温|あたた}めは{結構|けっこう}です。
examples.english: I don't need the bento heated, thanks.

examples.japanese: コンビニでお{弁当|べんとう}を{買|か}ったら{温|あたた}めてもらえる。
examples.english: When you buy a bento at a convenience store, they can heat it up for you.

notes:
お{弁当|べんとう}{温|あたた}め is a standard convenience store service in Japan.

COMMON PHRASES:
- 「お{弁当|べんとう}、{温|あたた}めますか？」(Would you like your bento heated?)
- 「お{願|ねが}いします」(Yes, please)
- 「{結構|けっこう}です」(No, thank you)

NOTE:
- This service is typically free at convenience stores.
- Some items have heating instructions printed on the packaging.
